about: Engine truth for the coach-accuracy regression games (docs/coach-accuracy-notes.md). One record per position (ply = plies played). Evaluations are from White's point of view; lines are best-first for the side to move, like the browser's PositionEval. Native Stockfish, one thread, ucinewgame before every position; depth 16 stands in for the browser's pass 1 (Stockfish 17 Lite, so not identical), depth 20 for the re-check. Regenerate with COACH_TRUTH_REGEN=1 npx vitest run src/lib/coach/__tests__/engineTruth.regen.test.ts.
